title: Waveshare ESP32-C6-ePaper-1.54-EN
summary: 1.54 英寸 200×200 SSD16xx-compatible command subset; die UNKNOWN，16 MiB Flash，无PSRAM。

value.factory: Exact original manufacturer image validated and run; full application partial
value.scope: Source paths are not proof of an accepted flash image. Absence is scoped to the complete pinned tree.

facts.label: 来源冲突与采用依据
value: Official1.54-inch V2 panel PDF does not identify a controller die. Reused digital SSD16xx-compatible commands do not establish physical SSD1681 identity.

Pinned V2 PDF R44/R45 POR defaults areXEnd15h/YEnd127h despite200×200 output. Factory partial initialization asserts physical RESET and then writes5000 bytes without reprogramming those windows; current snapshot is unreadable stripes, so reset/window compatibility is unresolved rather than hidden by a factory-specific bypass.
Optical image is retained across controller power-off/reset; bounded BUSY/commit is digital behaviour, not measured electrophoretic ghosting, LUT, temperature or scan calibration.

limitations: This model is a dimension/photo reconstruction, not manufacturer CAD.
Unmeasured depths, corner radii and connector contact geometry are explicit illustrative estimates; no fit, drop-in enclosure or hardware acceptance claim.
Source photographs are unchanged. Any display artwork shown in them is reference only; the live screen receives the simulator framebuffer.
Separate battery is included in the base SKU and omitted in -EN. This shared exterior does not fabricate an internal battery location.

Rear label, connector openings, actuator travel and internal supports remain reference-only because no matching native assembly was found. The visual rear cover is an approximate envelope, not a claim that the product has no ports.
BOOT remains a runtime keyboard/UI control. No imprecisely located exterior actuator is exposed as an exact3D input target.

collectionNotes: 部分适配：真实芯片与精确总线接线、数字显示/复位和已列出的输入子集；原厂完整交互、浏览器与实物未验收。
原始厂家合并镜像保持原字节，镜像/分区校验通过，真实ROM五秒执行0异常；不等于完整应用接受。
音频PCM、无线业务、模拟电源/充电/电池ADC、外部扩展和物理屏幕扫描/颜色尚未验收。
TF数字卡接口已接入；原厂记录未插卡，不能将无卡错误解释为无卡槽。
3D保留厂家CAD或尺寸依据，未知内部结构可检查为UNKNOWN；推测厚度/新增排针长度不能用作装配尺寸。
原厂最终快照 2 种RGB颜色；当前为单色或双色数字输出，界面交互仍待核验。
原厂最终画面为不可读条纹，存在RESET后窗口配置兼容问题；数字BUSY/保留墨迹已验证，但原厂界面未通过。
